edges.reason: Parameter a is consumed by the safeAdd addition.
Parameter b is consumed by the safeAdd addition.
Parameter a is consumed by the safeSub subtraction.
Parameter b is consumed by the safeSub subtraction.
Parameter a is consumed by the safeMul multiplication.
Parameter b is consumed by the safeMul multiplication.
Parameter a is consumed by the safeDiv division.
Parameter b is consumed by the safeDiv division and zero-check.
_newOwner is written into the privileged newOwner state.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
to is the credit target of transfer.
tokens is the amount debited and credited by transfer.
spender is the approval target in approve.
tokens is the allowance value stored by approve.
from is the debited account in transferFrom.
to is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens is the amount moved by transferFrom.
tokenOwner is the first key of the allowance lookup.
spender is the second key of the allowance lookup.
spender is both the approval target and the address of the external call.
tokens is stored as allowance and forwarded to the callee.
data is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress selects the arbitrary contract invoked by transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens is the amount forwarded to the external token transfer.
owner is initialised directly from the untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with owner to authorise transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
balances[msg.sender] is debited by transfer.
allowed[msg.sender][spender] is written by approve.
allowed[from][msg.sender] is spent by transferFrom.
msg.sender supplies the allowance key and the address passed to the external call.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner.
Ownership change only takes effect through the acceptOwnership second step.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
Constructor sets symbol to NBL.
Constructor sets name to NebuliToken.
Constructor sets decimals to 18.
Constructor sets the fixed total supply.
Constructor mints the entire supply to the deployer address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer debits via safeSub.
transfer credits via safeAdd.
transfer mutates both sides of the balances mapping.
approve overwrites the caller allowance unconditionally.
transferFrom debits balances and allowance via safeSub.
transferFrom credits the recipient via safeAdd.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on a caller-controlled contract.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes transfer on a caller-supplied token contract.
The rescued tokens are sent to the privileged owner address.
safeAdd performs an unchecked-style addition guarded only by require(c >= a).
safeSub performs a subtraction guarded only by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs a multiplication guarded by a division identity check.
The addition result is written into balances by transfer and transferFrom.
The subtraction result is written into balances by transfer and transferFrom.
Allowance state is already committed when the external call executes.
A malicious spender contract can re-enter transferFrom during the receiveApproval callback.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a of safeAdd has no independent security meaning; it is local to the arithmetic helper.
Parameter b of safeAdd has no independent security meaning; it is local to the arithmetic helper.
Parameter a of safeSub is only meaningful inside the subtraction helper.
Parameter b of safeSub is only meaningful inside the subtraction helper.
Parameter a of safeMul is local to the multiplication helper.
Parameter b of safeMul is local to the multiplication helper.
Parameter a of safeDiv is local to the division helper.
Parameter b of safeDiv is local to the division helper.
_newOwner is the sole input of the privileged ownership transfer and should be collapsed into it.
tokenOwner is only a lookup key inside the read-only balanceOf helper.
to is a transient recipient argument of transfer.
tokens is a transient amount argument of transfer.
spender is a transient approval key in approve.
tokens is a transient approval value in approve.
from is a transient debited account in transferFrom.
to is a transient credited account in transferFrom.
tokens is a transient amount argument in transferFrom.
tokenOwner is only a read key inside allowance.
spender is only a read key inside allowance.
spender becomes both the allowance key and the external callee target, so it belongs to the approveAndCall operation.
tokens is the forwarded amount and allowance of approveAndCall.
data is an opaque payload forwarded to the external callee.
tokenAddress is the caller-supplied target of the external token call and belongs to that operation.
tokens is the forwarded amount of the rescue call.
